g.text: `index.html` · static sidebar: Map, Entities, Profiles, Playlists tabs
`src/main.ts` · the app itself: state, viewport, markers, TransformControls
`bsp/parse.ts` · IBSP v46, 22 lumps → world mesh + model 0
`coords.ts` · Quake Z-up ↔ three.js Y-up, yaw conversion
`playerHull.ts` · spawn AABB from model 0, drawn as a box
`entities.ts` · Quake entity string → blocks, key/value, origin, yaw
`qrkCatalog.ts` · QuArK `SOFEntities.qrk`: toolbox tree, bit names, field options
`spawnflagsCatalog.ts` · checkbox editor from the qrk bit table
`sof1maps.ts` · GitHub API listing + zip → pick main `.bsp`
`sof1mapsCache.ts` · IndexedDB zip cache, keyed by repo path
`mapCache.ts` · last zip, folder, recent list in localStorage
**in the repo, not imported:** `ent_files/` — 998 per-map `.txt`, source material for profiles, no code path reads it
**read-only vendor drop:** `sof-sdk/` — Raven SDK headers `docs/bsp-sof.md` cites, never built
localStorage — map cache, playlists, current profile
three.js / WebGL — the only rendering dependency
static host — Pages, Netlify, any nginx, no backend
